agent.problem: The first-person quotation is introduced only as "the comeback." The card does not identify the grafted-in Gentile, or wild olive shoot, as the speaker before the quotation.

rule.text: When he quotes someone speaking as "I," he says who it is first.

agent.problem: The setup does not establish why the natural branches were broken off or how the Gentiles stand. The baker must guess the unseen wording "unbelief" and "faith" rather than reason out the meaning from the preceding cards.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
